home.title: KAIROS
home.heroSubline: Kairos is one workspace for coordinating teams, running projects and publishing the events that come out of them. No tab-switching, no lost context.
home.wsHeading: Three ways to work. One system underneath.
home.wsBody: Roles, access codes and progress tracking behave the same everywhere, so moving between an org, a team and your own notes costs you nothing.
home.wsOrgBody: Dedicated spaces with moderator, member and individual roles. Assign the work, watch progress land, keep the whole picture in one view.
home.wsTeamBody: Invite by access code, work in real time, and keep chat, tasks and timelines against the same project instead of three different tools.
home.wsPersonalBody: Private notes and deadlines that never leak into the team feed. Your own headspace, protected and searchable.
home.stripHeading: From first note to published page.
home.stripPlaceholderNote: [ placeholder frames — drop real product screenshots here ]
home.howOpenBody: Create an organization, a team or a private workspace. Share one access code to bring people in.
home.howRunBody: Tasks, deadlines, notes and timelines in one place, with progress visible to everyone who needs it.
home.howPublishBody: Turn the plan into a public event page with RSVPs, comments and location-based reach.
home.whyOneWorkflowBody: Plan, track and publish from a single interface instead of stitching four apps together.
home.whyPagesBody: Event pages carry your images, your details and your brand — not a generic template.
home.whySecureBody: Role-based access and protected documentation, so private notes stay private.
home.whyTimingBody: Interactive timelines and milestones make slippage obvious a week early, not a day late.
home.quoteBody: We stopped running the launch out of a spreadsheet and a group chat. Everything lives in one timeline now, and the event page comes out of the same place.
home.quoteAttribution: Placeholder quote — swap for a real customer
home.finalSubline: Set up a workspace in a minute. Bring the team with one code.
